---
title: "Publications"
format: html
---

::: {#pub-updated .small .text-muted}
:::

::: {#pub-sections}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
async function loadPublications() {
  const sectionsEl = document.getElementById("pub-sections");
  const updatedEl = document.getElementById("pub-updated");

  // Type -> section heading / icon. Anything not listed falls into "other".
  const TYPE_META = {
    "journal-article":  { label: "Peer-Reviewed Publications", icon: "bi-journal-check" },
    "preprint":         { label: "Preprints",                  icon: "bi-file-earmark-text" },
    "conference-paper": { label: "Conference Presentations",   icon: "bi-easel2" },
    "other":            { label: "Other",                      icon: "bi-bookmark" },
  };
  const TYPE_ORDER = ["journal-article", "preprint", "conference-paper", "other"];

  // Turns a journal name into the filename this entry's cover thumbnail
  // would need, e.g. "Journal of Animal Ecology" -> "journal-of-animal-ecology".
  // Drop a matching .jpg/.png into images/journal-covers/ and it's picked up
  // automatically; otherwise the type icon is shown instead.
  function slugify(s) {
    return (s || "")
      .toLowerCase()
      .normalize("NFKD").replace(new RegExp("[\\u0300-\\u036f]", "g"), "")
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
  }

  try {
    // Works when _data is published with site output.
    const res = await fetch("/_data/publications.json", { cache: "no-store" });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();

    const items = data.items || [];
    if (data.updated_at) {
      const dt = new Date(data.updated_at);
      updatedEl.textContent = `Last updated: ${dt.toLocaleString()}`;
    }

    if (!items.length) {
      sectionsEl.innerHTML = "<p>No publications found.</p>";
      return;
    }

    // Group by type, preserving each item's existing (year-descending) order.
    const groups = {};
    items.forEach((p) => {
      const key = TYPE_ORDER.includes(p.type) ? p.type : "other";
      (groups[key] = groups[key] || []).push(p);
    });

    TYPE_ORDER.forEach((key) => {
      const groupItems = groups[key];
      if (!groupItems || !groupItems.length) return;

      const meta = TYPE_META[key];

      const section = document.createElement("section");
      section.className = "pub-section";

      const heading = document.createElement("h2");
      heading.innerHTML = `<i class="bi ${meta.icon} me-2" aria-hidden="true"></i>${meta.label}`;
      section.appendChild(heading);

      const list = document.createElement("div");
      list.className = "pub-cards";

      groupItems.forEach((p) => {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = "pub-card";

        const authors = (p.authors || []).join(", ");
        const year = p.year ? ` (${p.year}).` : ".";
        const journal = p.journal ? ` <em>${p.journal}</em>.` : "";

        const buttons = [];
        if (p.doi_url) {
          buttons.push(
            `<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" href="${p.doi_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
               <i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right me-1" aria-hidden="true"></i>DOI
             </a>`
          );
        }
        if (p.url && p.url !== p.doi_url) {
          buttons.push(
            `<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" href="${p.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
               <i class="bi bi-link-45deg me-1" aria-hidden="true"></i>Link
             </a>`
          );
        }
        if (p.preprint_url) {
          buttons.push(
            `<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" href="${p.preprint_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
               <i class="bi bi-file-earmark-text me-1" aria-hidden="true"></i>Preprint
             </a>`
          );
        }

        // Icon container built with real DOM nodes (not an HTML string) so
        // the fallback-icon markup never has to be quote-escaped into an
        // inline event-handler attribute.
        const iconEl = document.createElement("div");
        iconEl.className = "pub-icon";

        function showFallbackIcon() {
          iconEl.innerHTML = `<i class="bi ${meta.icon}" aria-hidden="true"></i>`;
        }

        // Try a curated cover thumbnail first (images/journal-covers/), most
        // specific filename first, falling back to the type icon if nothing
        // matches. Candidates, in order:
        //   1. p.cover               - explicit override (cite/overrides.yaml)
        //   2. <slug>-<year>-<volume> - same journal, different volume art
        //   3. <slug>-<year>          - same journal, different year's art
        //   4. <slug>                 - the journal's default cover
        const slug = slugify(p.journal);
        const stems = [];
        if (p.cover) stems.push(p.cover);
        if (slug && p.year && p.volume) stems.push(`${slug}-${p.year}-${p.volume}`);
        if (slug && p.year) stems.push(`${slug}-${p.year}`);
        if (slug) stems.push(slug);

        if (stems.length) {
          const img = document.createElement("img");
          img.alt = "";
          img.loading = "lazy";

          let stemIdx = 0;
          let triedPng = false;
          function tryNext() {
            if (stemIdx >= stems.length) {
              showFallbackIcon();
              return;
            }
            const ext = triedPng ? "png" : "jpg";
            img.src = `/images/journal-covers/${stems[stemIdx]}.${ext}`;
          }
          img.addEventListener("error", () => {
            if (!triedPng) {
              triedPng = true;
            } else {
              triedPng = false;
              stemIdx += 1;
            }
            tryNext();
          });
          iconEl.appendChild(img);
          tryNext();
        } else {
          showFallbackIcon();
        }

        const bodyEl = document.createElement("div");
        bodyEl.className = "pub-body";
        bodyEl.innerHTML = `
          <div class="pub-title">${p.title ?? "Untitled"}</div>
          <div class="pub-meta">${authors}${year}${journal}</div>
          ${buttons.length ? `<div class="pub-buttons">${buttons.join("")}</div>` : ""}
        `;

        card.appendChild(iconEl);
        card.appendChild(bodyEl);
        list.appendChild(card);
      });

      section.appendChild(list);
      sectionsEl.appendChild(section);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    sectionsEl.innerHTML = `<p>Could not load publications data.</p>`;
    console.error(err);
  }
}

loadPublications();
</script>
```
